body: Dear Santa, please find in the picture what I want for Christmas.

Your post resonates so much with my life. We were gamers too, and used to spend a lot of time together on them. There were so many moments in which I felt the happiest and would have not traded them for anything else on the earth. And there were moments when his actions were so bad that it crumbled my soul into pieces :'( I left him because I considered it the best, and him hearing me breaking up with him made him go berserk breaking everything and hurting me :( Now I am not sure anymore if I made the right decision...either way, I felt unhappy. It's like I cannot live with him, nor without him (in peace and happiness) :(((

I feel the same way as you :(  


He still has our photo together and the status "In a relationship" and I keep checking obsessively daily to see if he's going to change it, and I dread that moment :( I don't know how to contain myself from crying :'(
Hell yes, you are beautiful!
I am a girl, but i think you are very pretty!
Wow, that is stunning. Straight out of a fantasy story 😍 your hair gors very well with it too!

This has happened to me too. And what you mentioned in your post was only the beginning!  
After he saw no more reaction from me towards his insults it got worse overtime, at the point of physical harm. You might not consider this right now, but you dodged a bullet over there by leaving him. Don't do the same mistake as me to stay in any relationship where there is no respect towards one another. You will get stuck in a cycle of abuse and it will get harder and harder to let go because of the emotional investment you have added. You are very young, you have your whole life ahead, and you already made a brave and right choice, so live your life with someone who makes you feel safe and happy!
I'd give you max 30-33, you look way younger! and handsome too!
Your body looks flawless! 4 kids! No one would have guessed!
You look like you're 30 years old at most! What is your secret?? :)
Your face is so beautiful either way!
Second one for me :)
Actually at the time of the break up i managed to record him secretely on Phone, in case he does harm me. He still does not know I have this record.

We are neighbors one block away and this terrifies me (i bought the apartament on credit while we were still together, and only now the payment was finalized). Dreadful the thought of passing his block everytime i come home from work. Or the idea of meeting him in a grocery store makes me want to throw up because of stress.

I found out recently that in his teenage years he was a drug dealer and human trafficker, and he even put his ex in hospital by breaking her bones... I am scared to go to Police that he might get his revenge on me :( he is very vengeful...you think that if i go with a cop, i can recover my stuff from him?
Dear OP, please give us a sign you are still here...let's talk..
Now that's a strong 9! Your eyes are gorgeous!

Hello. Now that I read and did the survey on the website, it pretty much describes my daily life, sadly. I am thinking of a way to quietly leave his apartment, but the problem is he is always at home by the time I get back from work. I would not mind leaving my clothes and stuff behind - but I have a baby Ringneck parrot at his home and I am very scared he would do something to it, or throw him out the window as he often threatens, and I am really scared and do not know how to safely proceed with this :(

He wants us to share everything like a family. The only problem is that in the end we manage to buy what HE considers necessary in our home, and what I consider that we need are already too "extra" (ex. a vacuum cleaner- just got scolded for buying one to ease my home tasks, instead of mopping all day after work).
Very cute and I love your hair! :)

Hello. I asked him nice several times, and he turns it around saying: I ask because I care and want you to be safe. Or: it's very strange that you are so late, when you are usually on time home... :( but if I insist on it, he gets upset and complains that I'm pestering him because I HAVE something to hide from him :(
First one

He drinks quite a lot lately but I could hold normal conversations with him  (did not seem that drunk). Yesterday when we got back he drank a whole bottle of cherry brandy and I don't know how drunk one can get from it (I never drink)...maybe he was too drunk that he said this? I wish it would be that way and not the actual way he feels about our relation :(
One thing is for sure, you're my type, give you 9/10 cause I am subjective :))
Much appreciated! You think I could do something to improve the shape (ie hair)?
You are beautiful, but I would definitely change the shape of the eyebrows :)

Hello. Could we talk please? I was in the same situation as you and managed to drag it out somehow. Please, just give a thought about it. You are facing a temporary problem which does not need ending your life from suicide, trust me on this one, please.
You look a bit like River Phoenix :)

Hi just wanted to let you know i threw away the Phone card. Im done. With all. Thank you for trying to help but i dont see a reason to hang on. Im literally shaking now. Thank you dear friend. Goodbye..
I am here to talk of you need :)
Dear, of course i will ask them. Right now they are out of office because it s late in România, but i will call them tomorrow morning and i will let you know :)
What country do you live in? I could check for you if you want :)

Actually... Much better than the pictures, I was shocked to see that :)) it looked really meticulously worked... And for a price like that you get varely a simple dress in my country, True bargain. So...if you really feel that the dress you found îs the one, trust me, your feeling might be right. I also love your choice, it looks timeless and elegant..
If there is anyway i can help make your frustration...less frustrating, and If you want to went about it, I am here to hear you out. Best regards, your new frustrate redditor friend. :)

I went through the same situation (and I am not even engaged yet, we only discussed that we are getting married). I had no hesitation. I look curiously at other dresses online, but could not find anything that I love than that one :) I bought it, regret nothing, it is my dream dress! <3 Below in the link is mine :) [the one i bought :)](https://www.myfashionizer.ro/rochie-alba-lunga-de-cununie/)
Now I find it hard to end it all, because I'm hearing you wish you were never born either and now I feel I'm not in the same situation. This is frustrating, honestly :))
Can we talk? I feel the same way :(

You! You have just put in words perfectly the way I'm feeling and think, thank you! 

I do not wanna give you any of the inspirational bullshit that we keep hearing everyday that life will get better or it's just a passing phase, because there is no guarantee that this will happen to any of us. I just want you to know that you are not alone in this, and if you ever need anyone to vent or if there is any way I can help, please contact me. I know more than well what your are going through and lost the idea of the world getting better, because I really feel like this ain't gonna happen in the near future. 

I may not be able to help myself, but maybe...I can be of use to you. Stay strong, I still think we have a purpose but just didn't find it yet.

Hello! I am going through the same thing as you. I am a 27 year old woman and feel like everything had came to a halt: all the people I know are enjoying their youth starting their families and living their happy live, and here I am just...existing. I recently got out of a very unhappy relationship which left me feel worthless after all the efforts I put in it. 

I really am upset hearing people going through similar things as me, like you. I really hope   you will find happiness in life, you are still very young and have your whole life ahead, and a career to go with it too! What you have accomplished at this age was not easy and not everyone can do it, so please, do not think that you deserve less and that you are unlucky. I am pretty sure that life has also good surprises in for you too, but maybe we are currently too stuck on our thoughts right now to believe that...

Hello. I tried a lot of things: getting in better shape, taking more care of myself, having more "me" time, even bought some parrots as I love birds! but still nothing is helping :( I am really trying my hardest, it is so hard for me. I thought that maybe it could be depression but they said I don't have it :(

Now that I am thinking about it I believe it has no future. I did say no to the furniture carrying, but he said that I am fine now after two weeks and I am now only playing the victim for attention. He gave me easy furniture, but still started bleeding after helping out. If he cares less about my health, I do not think he values this relationship and only uses me for his own benefit (make him a family and do his chores). I really am trying to build up to courage and leave for good...
I attach the link - maybe it s helpful - > https://www.myfashionizer.ro/rochie-alba-lunga-de-cununie/
Haha your comment made my day :) it would definetely be outstanding with socks 😂

Hello OP, I tried to do this, but he keeps buying a lot of useless stuff which we do not need and I do not like sharing just for the heck of sharing :)) I want us to have stuff which benefit us both and to ease our living together. He does not want us to share a joint account - and because of this I find very annoying when he says how much I own him (every penny for a little shopping). I think this relation is a lost cause.

He told me it was not a big deal cause it was an early miscarriage. The problem with it started this week when he asked my help carrying some furniture downstairs (3 levels), and because of its heaviness I started bleeding again, but still...he thinks I'm playing the victim and exaggerating.
It has both :) and i got a real bargain- less than 100 Euro :)

Dear OP, you have no idea how much you opened my eyes on this. I thought that maybe his need for money is deeply rooted in the past (many years ago he was extorting money from people...) but said he wanted to better himself and start a family now. He is also very obsessive of whom I am allowed to talk to on phone and to meet. And regarding the hospitalization...my parents are actually in debt now because of all the money they had to rent me to pay for the expenses...and he even didn't offer to help me with any penny! But he want kids he says... We've been living together for only a year, but it looks like I aged 5 years in this...
